conclusion.unequalBinaryHashesExplained: The binaries contain different mimalloc compilation timestamps and different Rust standard-library source-location strings. Those linked-data differences change section sizes and addresses.
conclusion.causalBisectCaveat: A comparison against the historical release artifact confounds product changes with cross-build-host artifact variation. Use the identically rebuilt AF4 baseline for source attribution. The linked-layout difference has not been shown to cause the observed timing deltas.

buildHostEvidence.description: Preserved handoff identifies the new xbabe3 common-Q v5.1.1 binary by its exact 2a5a1ea4 hash.

normalization: Index instructions by virtual address minus that binary's .text start.
Replace only rip+0x... or rip-0x... data displacements with rip+DATA_ADDRESS.
Rebase direct call/jump/loop targets by the .text start.
Hash sorted lines formatted as lowercase-hex-offset, space, normalized instruction, joined by newline without a final newline.
instructionComparison.interpretation: All decoded instructions, registers, other immediates, non-RIP addressing forms and relative control-flow targets match after address normalization. This includes statically linked native allocator code.
instructionComparison.limitation: Masking RIP-relative addresses does not prove that every referenced data value is identical. This establishes matching instruction structure, not complete semantic equivalence of linked data. The observed timing differences cannot be causally attributed from this static comparison.

stringDifferences.extraction: Every maximal printable-ASCII sequence of length at least 6, over the complete ELF, compared as sets.
stringDifferences.rustPathRemappingCause: Unestablished: the original dependency build invocation/environment was not retained in build.json. Local rust-src and rustc installation timestamps predate the historical build, so a recent local rust-src installation is not supported.
